title: XRZero-G0: Pushing the Frontier of Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Interfaces, Quality and Ratios
summary: The acquisition of high-quality, action-aligned demonstration data remains a fundamental bottleneck in scaling foundation models for dexterous robot manipulation. Although robot-free human demonstrations (e.g., the UMI paradigm) offer a scalable alternative to traditional teleoperation, current systems are constrained by sub-optimal hardware ergonomics, open-loop workflows, and a lack of systematic data-mixing strategies. To address these limitations, we present XRZero-G0, a hardware-software co-designed system for embodied data collection and policy learning. The system features an ergonomic, virtual reality interface equipped with a top-view camera and dual specialized grippers to directly improve collection efficiency. To ensure dataset reliability, we propose a closed-loop collection, inspection, training, and evaluation pipeline for non-proprioceptive data. This workflow achieves an 85% data validity rate and establishes a transparent mechanism for quality control. Furthermore, we investigate the empirical scaling behaviors and optimal mixing ratios of robot-free data. Extensive experiments indicate that combining a minimal volume of real-robot data with large-scale robot-free data (e.g., a 10:1 ratio) achieves performance comparable to exclusively real-robot datasets, while reducing acquisition costs by a factor of twenty. Utilizing XRZero-G0, we construct a 2,000-hour robot-free dataset that enables zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer to a target physical robot, demonstrating a highly scalable methodology for generalized real-world manipulation.Our project repository: https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/XRZero-G0
tldr: The paper introduces a hardware-software system for collecting high-quality, robot-free human demonstrations for dexterous manipulation, enabling efficient data scaling and zero-shot transfer to physical robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种软硬件协同设计的系统，用于为灵巧机器人操控收集高质量的、非机器人的演示数据，实现了高效的数据扩展和向物理机器人的零样本迁移。
summary_zh: 获取高质量且与动作精准对齐的示范数据，仍然是提升灵巧机器人操作基础模型规模化的一个根本瓶颈。尽管脱离机器人的人类示范（如UMI范式）为传统遥操作提供了可扩展的替代方案，但现有系统受限于硬件人机工学设计欠佳、开环工作流程，以及缺乏系统化的数据混合策略。为解决这些局限，我们提出了XRZero-G0——一个为具身数据收集与策略学习而协同设计的软硬件系统。该系统配备具备顶视摄像头和双专用抓手的虚拟现实接口，其人机工学设计直接提升了数据收集效率。为确保数据集的可靠性，我们提出了一套针对非本体感知数据的闭环收集、检查、训练与评估流程，实现了85%的数据有效率，并建立起透明的质量控制机制。此外，我们深入研究了脱离机器人数据的经验扩展规律与最优混合比例。大量实验表明，将少量真实机器人数据与大规模脱离机器人数据相结合（例如10:1的比例），能够达到与纯真实机器人数据集相当的性能，同时将数据获取成本降低二十倍。利用XRZero-G0，我们构建了一个2000小时的脱离机器人数据集，实现了向目标物理机器人的零样本跨实体迁移，展示了面向通用真实世界操作的强可扩展性方法。项目代码库地址：https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/XRZero-G0

title: Tree Learning: A Multi-Skill Continual Learning Framework for Humanoid Robots
summary: As reinforcement learning for humanoid robots evolves from single-task to multi-skill paradigms, efficiently expanding new skills while avoiding catastrophic forgetting has become a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing approaches either rely on complex topology adjustments in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models or require training extremely large-scale models, making lightweight deployment difficult. To address this, we propose Tree Learning, a multi-skill continual learning framework for humanoid robots. The framework adopts a root-branch hierarchical parameter inheritance mechanism, providing motion priors for branch skills through parameter reuse to fundamentally prevent catastrophic forgetting. A multi-modal feedforward adaptation mechanism combining phase modulation and interpolation is designed to support both periodic and aperiodic motions. A task-level reward shaping strategy is also proposed to accelerate skill convergence. Unity-based simulation experiments show that, in contrast to simultaneous multi-task training, Tree Learning achieves higher rewards across various representative locomotion skills while maintaining a 100% skill retention rate, enabling seamless multi-skill switching and real-time interactive control. We further validate the performance and generalization capability of Tree Learning on two distinct Unity-simulated tasks: a Super Mario-inspired interactive scenario and autonomous navigation in a classical Chinese garden environment.
tldr: Proposes Tree Learning, a hierarchical continual learning framework for humanoid robots to efficiently acquire and retain multiple skills without catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于人形机器人的分层持续学习框架——树学习，该框架可有效习得和保留多种技能，避免灾难性遗忘。
summary_zh: 随着人形机器人强化学习从单任务向多技能范式演进，如何在有效扩展新技能的同时避免灾难性遗忘，已成为具身智能领域的关键挑战。现有方法要么依赖于混合专家模型复杂的拓扑结构调整，要么需要训练极大规模模型，难以实现轻量化部署。为此，我们提出面向人形机器人的树状学习框架——一种多技能持续学习框架。该框架采用根-支分层参数继承机制，通过参数复用为分支技能提供运动先验，从根本上防止灾难性遗忘。设计了融合相位调制与插值的多模态前馈适应机制，同时支持周期性与非周期性运动。此外，还提出了任务级奖励塑形策略以加速技能收敛。基于Unity的仿真实验表明，相比多任务同步训练，树状学习在保持100%技能留存率的同时，在各类代表性运动技能中均获得更高奖励，实现了多技能无缝切换与实时交互控制。我们进一步在两类差异化的Unity仿真任务中验证了树状学习的性能与泛化能力：受《超级马里奥》启发的交互场景，以及经典中式园林环境下的自主导航任务。

title: Robotic Manipulation is Vision-to-Geometry Mapping ($f(v) \rightarrow G$): Vision-Geometry Backbones over Language and Video Models
summary: At its core, robotic manipulation is a problem of vision-to-geometry mapping ($f(v) \rightarrow G$). Physical actions are fundamentally defined by geometric properties like 3D positions and spatial relationships. Consequently, we argue that the foundation for generalizable robotic control should be a vision-geometry backbone, rather than the widely adopted vision-language or video models. Conventional VLA and video-predictive models rely on backbones pretrained on large-scale 2D image-text or temporal pixel data. While effective, their representations are largely shaped by semantic concepts or 2D priors, which do not intrinsically align with the precise 3D geometric nature required for physical manipulation. Driven by this insight, we propose the Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) model, which directly conditions action generation on pretrained native 3D representations. Specifically, VGA replaces conventional language or video backbones with a pretrained 3D world model, establishing a seamless vision-to-geometry mapping that translates visual inputs directly into physical actions. To further enhance geometric consistency, we introduce a Progressive Volumetric Modulation module and adopt a joint training strategy. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. In simulation benchmarks, VGA outperforms top-tier VLA baselines including $π_{0.5}$ and GeoVLA, demonstrating its superiority in precise manipulation. More importantly, VGA exhibits remarkable zero-shot generalization to unseen viewpoints in real-world deployments, consistently outperforming $π_{0.5}$. These results highlight that operating on native 3D representations-rather than translating through language or 2D video priors-is a highly promising direction for achieving generalizable physical intelligence.
tldr: This paper argues that robotic manipulation is fundamentally a vision-to-geometry mapping problem and proposes a Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) model that uses a pretrained 3D world model backbone instead of vision-language or video models for more precise control and better generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文认为机器人操作本质上是视觉到几何的映射问题，并提出了一种Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) 模型，使用预训练的3D世界模型作为主干，而非传统的视觉-语言或视频模型，以实现更精确的控制和更强的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 机器人操纵的核心在于视觉到几何的映射问题（$f(v) \rightarrow G$）。物理动作本质上是由三维位置和空间关系等几何属性定义的。因此，我们认为通用化机器人控制的基础应当是一个视觉-几何主干网络，而非当前广泛采用的视觉-语言或视频模型。传统的视觉语言模型与视频预测模型依赖在大规模二维图像-文本或时序像素数据上预训练的主干网络。虽然这些方法有效，但其表征主要受语义概念或二维先验影响，与物理操纵所需的精确三维几何特性并不本质契合。基于这一洞见，我们提出了视觉-几何-动作模型，该模型直接在预训练的原始三维表征上构建动作生成机制。具体而言，VGA 采用预训练的三维世界模型替代传统语言或视频主干网络，建立无缝的视觉-几何映射，将视觉输入直接转化为物理动作。为进一步增强几何一致性，我们提出了渐进式体素调制模块并采用联合训练策略。大量实验验证了本方法的有效性。在仿真基准测试中，VGA 的表现优于包括 $π_{0.5}$ 和 GeoVLA 在内的顶尖视觉语言模型基线，证明了其在精确操纵任务中的优越性。更重要的是，在现实场景部署中，VGA 对未见视角展现出显著的零样本泛化能力，其性能持续超越 $π_{0.5}$。这些结果表明：基于原始三维表征进行运算——而非通过语言或二维视频先验进行转换——是实现通用化物理智能极具前景的研究方向。

title: FastGrasp: Learning-based Whole-body Control method for Fast Dexterous Grasping with Mobile Manipulators
summary: Fast grasping is critical for mobile robots in logistics, manufacturing, and service applications. Existing methods face fundamental challenges in impact stabilization under high-speed motion, real-time whole-body coordination, and generalization across diverse objects and scenarios, limited by fixed bases, simple grippers, or slow tactile response capabilities. We propose \textbf{FastGrasp}, a learning-based framework that integrates grasp guidance, whole-body control, and tactile feedback for mobile fast grasping. Our two-stage reinforcement learning strategy first generates diverse grasp candidates via conditional variational autoencoder conditioned on object point clouds, then executes coordinated movements of mobile base, arm, and hand guided by optimal grasp selection. Tactile sensing enables real-time grasp adjustments to handle impact effects and object variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior grasping performance in both simulation and real-world scenarios, achieving robust manipulation across diverse object geometries through effective sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: The paper proposes FastGrasp, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework combining grasp planning, whole-body control, and tactile feedback for high-speed, dexterous grasping with mobile manipulators, demonstrating robust sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了FastGrasp，一个两阶段强化学习框架，结合抓取规划、全身控制和触觉反馈，用于移动机械臂的高速灵巧抓取，并展示了鲁棒的从仿真到现实的迁移能力。
summary_zh: 摘要：快速抓取是物流、制造和服务应用中移动机器人的关键能力。现有方法因受限于固定基座、简单夹具或迟缓的触觉响应能力，在高速运动下的冲击稳定、实时全身协调以及跨多类物体与场景的泛化能力方面面临根本性挑战。本文提出\textbf{FastGrasp}——一种基于学习的框架，集成了抓取引导、全身控制与触觉反馈，以实现移动式快速抓取。我们采用两阶段强化学习策略：首先通过以物体点云为条件的条件变分自编码器生成多样化的抓取候选方案，随后根据最优抓取选择，协调执行移动基座、机械臂与手爪的联动运动。触觉感知实现了实时抓取调整，以应对冲击效应与物体差异。大量实验验证了本方法在仿真和真实场景中的卓越抓取性能，通过有效的仿真到现实迁移，实现了跨不同几何形状物体的鲁棒操作。

title: PAINT: Partner-Agnostic Intent-Aware Cooperative Transport with Legged Robots
summary: Collaborative transport requires robots to infer partner intent through physical interaction while maintaining stable loco-manipulation. This becomes particularly challenging in complex environments, where interaction signals are difficult to capture and model. We present PAINT, a lightweight yet efficient hierarchical learning framework for partner-agonistic intent-aware collaborative legged transport that infers partner intent directly from proprioceptive feedback. PAINT decouples intent understanding from terrain-robust locomotion: A high-level policy infers the partner interaction wrench using an intent estimator and a teacher-student training scheme, while a low-level locomotion backbone ensures robust execution. This enables lightweight deployment without external force-torque sensing or payload tracking. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate compliant cooperative transport across diverse terrains, payloads, and partners. Furthermore, we show that PAINT naturally scales to decentralized multi-robot transport and transfers across robot embodiments by swapping the underlying locomotion backbone. Our results suggest that proprioceptive signals in payload-coupled interaction provide a scalable interface for partner-agnostic intent-aware collaborative transport.
tldr: PAINT is a hierarchical learning framework for partner-agnostic, intent-aware collaborative transport with legged robots, using proprioceptive feedback and a teacher-student scheme to infer partner intent and achieve compliant transport across diverse terrains, payloads, and partners.
tldr_zh: PAINT 是一个用于足式机器人无特定伙伴意图感知协同运输的层次化学习框架，它利用本体感知反馈和师生训练方案推断伙伴意图，实现了跨不同地形、负载和伙伴的顺应性运输。
summary_zh: 协作运输要求机器人通过物理交互推断伙伴意图，同时保持稳定的运动操控。这在复杂环境中尤为困难，因为交互信号难以捕捉和建模。我们提出PAINT框架——一种轻量且高效的分层学习架构，用于实现与伙伴无关的意图感知式腿式机器人协作运输。该框架仅通过本体感知反馈直接推断伙伴意图：高层策略采用意图估计器与师生训练机制来推测伙伴交互力矩，而底层运动主干网络则确保鲁棒执行。这一设计无需外部力扭矩传感或负载跟踪即可实现轻量化部署。大量仿真与真实世界实验表明，该系统能在不同地形、负载及协作伙伴条件下完成柔顺的协同运输任务。此外，我们证实PAINT框架可自然扩展至去中心化多机器人运输系统，并通过替换底层运动主干网络实现跨机器人平台的迁移。研究结果表明，负载耦合交互中的本体感知信号为构建可扩展的、与伙伴无关的意图感知协作运输系统提供了有效接口。

title: Learning Versatile Humanoid Manipulation with Touch Dreaming
summary: Humanoid robots promise general-purpose assistance, yet real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging because it requires whole-body stability, dexterous hands, and contact-aware perception under frequent contact changes. In this work, we study dexterous, contact-rich humanoid loco-manipulation. We first develop an RL-based whole-body controller that provides stable lower-body and torso execution during complex manipulation. Built on this controller, we develop a whole-body humanoid data collection system that combines VR-based teleoperation with human-to-humanoid motion mapping, enabling efficient collection of real-world demonstrations. We then propose Humanoid Transformer with Touch Dreaming (HTD), a multimodal encoder--decoder Transformer that models touch as a core modality alongside multi-view vision and proprioception. HTD is trained in a single stage with behavioral cloning augmented by touch dreaming: in addition to predicting action chunks, the policy predicts future hand-joint forces and future tactile latents, encouraging the shared Transformer trunk to learn contact-aware representations for dexterous interaction. Across five contact-rich tasks, Insert-T, Book Organization, Towel Folding, Cat Litter Scooping, and Tea Serving, HTD achieves a 90.9% relative improvement in average success rate over the stronger baseline. Ablation results further show that latent-space tactile prediction is more effective than raw tactile prediction, yielding a 30% relative gain in success rate. These results demonstrate that combining robust whole-body execution, scalable humanoid data collection, and predictive touch-centered learning enables versatile, high-dexterity humanoid manipulation in the real world. Project webpage: humanoid-touch-dream.github.io.
tldr: The paper introduces a method for training humanoid robots in complex loco-manipulation tasks by developing a robust whole-body controller, a scalable teleoperation data collection system, and a Transformer-based policy with a novel 'touch dreaming' auxiliary task that predicts future tactile information to improve contact-aware learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种训练人形机器人进行复杂移动操作任务的方法，通过开发鲁棒的全身控制器、可扩展的遥操作数据收集系统，以及一种带有新颖‘触觉预测’辅助任务的基于Transformer的策略，预测未来触觉信息以改进接触感知学习。
summary_zh: 人形机器人有望实现通用辅助功能，然而现实世界中的人形移动操作仍面临严峻挑战，因为它需要在频繁接触变化中保持全身稳定性、具备灵巧手部能力以及接触感知能力。本研究致力于探索灵巧且接触密集的人形移动操作。我们首先开发了一种基于强化学习的全身控制器，该控制器能在复杂操作过程中提供稳定的下半身与躯干执行。在此基础上，我们构建了结合VR遥操作与人体动作映射的全身人形数据采集系统，实现了现实世界示范数据的高效收集。进而提出了触觉梦境人形变换器——一种多模态编码器-解码器变换器架构，该模型将触觉作为与多视角视觉及本体感知并列的核心模态进行建模。通过单阶段行为克隆训练并结合触觉梦境增强：策略网络不仅预测动作序列，还同时预测未来手部关节力与未来触觉潜在表征，促使共享变换器主干网络学习面向灵巧交互的接触感知表征。在插入-T、书籍整理、毛巾折叠、猫砂铲取和茶水侍奉五项接触密集型任务中，该模型相较于更强基线实现了平均成功率90.9%的相对提升。消融实验结果进一步表明，潜在空间触觉预测相较于原始触觉预测更为有效，可带来30%的相对成功率增益。这些结果表明：结合稳健的全身执行系统、可扩展的人形数据采集方法以及以触觉为核心的预测性学习机制，能够实现现实世界中多功能、高灵巧度的人形操作。项目网页：humanoid-touch-dream.github.io。

title: E2E-Fly: An Integrated Training-to-Deployment System for End-to-End Quadrotor Autonomy
summary: Training and transferring learning-based policies for quadrotors from simulation to reality remains challenging due to inefficient visual rendering, physical modeling inaccuracies, unmodeled sensor discrepancies, and the absence of a unified platform integrating differentiable physics learning into end-to-end training. While recent work has demonstrated various end-to-end quadrotor control tasks, few systems provide a systematic, zero-shot transfer pipeline, hindering reproducibility and real-world deployment. To bridge this gap, we introduce E2E-Fly, an integrated framework featuring an agile quadrotor platform coupled with a full-stack training, validation, and deployment workflow. The training framework incorporates a high-performance simulator with support for differentiable physics learning and reinforcement learning, alongside structured reward design tailored to common quadrotor tasks. We further introduce a two-stage validation strategy using sim-to-sim transfer and hardware-in-the-loop testing, and deploy policies onto two physical quadrotor platforms via a dedicated low-level control interface and a comprehensive sim-to-real alignment methodology, encompassing system identification, domain randomization, latency compensation, and noise modeling. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically unify differentiable physical learning with training, validation, and real-world deployment for quadrotors. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for training six end-to-end control tasks and deploy them in the real world.
tldr: E2E-Fly is an integrated system for training and deploying end-to-end learning-based policies for quadrotors, featuring a differentiable physics simulator, sim-to-real transfer, and real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: E2E-Fly是一个用于训练和部署四旋翼无人机端到端学习策略的集成系统，包含可微分物理模拟器、仿真到现实迁移和实际部署功能。
summary_zh: 将基于学习的四旋翼飞行器策略从仿真训练迁移到现实应用仍面临诸多挑战，包括视觉渲染效率低下、物理建模不准确、传感器差异未建模，以及缺乏集成可微分物理学习与端到端训练的统一平台。尽管近期研究展示了多种端到端四旋翼控制任务，但鲜有系统能提供系统化的零样本迁移流程，这阻碍了研究的可复现性与实际部署。为填补这一空白，我们提出了E2E-Fly——一个集成敏捷四旋翼硬件平台与全栈训练、验证及部署流程的框架。该训练框架包含支持可微分物理学习与强化学习的高性能仿真器，并针对常见四旋翼任务设计了结构化奖励机制。我们进一步提出了基于仿真间迁移与硬件在环测试的两阶段验证策略，并通过专用底层控制接口及完整的仿真-现实对齐方法（涵盖系统辨识、领域随机化、延迟补偿与噪声建模）将策略部署至两个实体四旋翼平台。据我们所知，这是首个系统化融合可微分物理学习与四旋翼训练、验证及现实部署的工作。最后，我们通过训练六项端到端控制任务并在真实场景中部署，验证了所提框架的有效性。

title: Frequency-aware Decomposition Learning for Sensorless Wrench Forecasting on a Vibration-rich Hydraulic Manipulator
summary: Force and torque (F/T) sensing is critical for robot-environment interaction, but physical F/T sensors impose constraints in size, cost, and fragility. To mitigate this, recent studies have estimated force/wrench sensorlessly from robot internal states. While existing methods generally target relatively slow interactions, tasks involving rapid interactions, such as grinding, can induce task-critical high-frequency vibrations, and estimation in such robotic settings remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose a Frequency-aware Decomposition Network (FDN) for short-term forecasting of vibration-rich wrench from proprioceptive history. FDN predicts spectrally decomposed wrench with asymmetric deterministic and probabilistic heads, modeling the high-frequency residual as a learned conditional distribution. It further incorporates frequency-awareness to adaptively enhance input spectra with learned filtering and impose a frequency-band prior on the outputs. We pretrain FDN on a large-scale open-source robot dataset and transfer the learned proprioception-to-wrench representation to the downstream. On real-world grinding excavation data from a 6-DoF hydraulic manipulator and under a delayed estimation setting, FDN outperforms baseline estimators and forecasters in the high-frequency band and remains competitive in the low-frequency band. Transfer learning provides additional gains, suggesting the potential of large-scale pretraining and transfer learning for robotic wrench estimation. Code and data will be made available upon acceptance.
tldr: This paper proposes a frequency-aware deep learning method for sensorless force/torque (wrench) forecasting on a hydraulic manipulator, specifically targeting vibration-rich tasks like grinding. It uses pretraining and transfer learning from a large-scale robot dataset to improve high-frequency estimation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种频率感知的深度学习网络，用于在振动丰富的液压机械手上进行无传感器力矩预测，并针对研磨等任务。该方法使用大规模机器人数据进行预训练和迁移学习，以提升高频估计性能。
summary_zh: 力与力矩传感对于机器人与环境的交互至关重要，但物理力/力矩传感器在尺寸、成本和耐用性方面存在局限。为缓解此问题，近年研究尝试从机器人内部状态无传感器地估计力/力矩。现有方法通常针对相对缓慢的交互任务，而涉及快速交互的任务（如打磨）可能引发任务关键的高频振动，此类场景下的力/力矩估计研究仍显不足。为此，本文提出一种频率感知分解网络，用于基于本体感知历史数据对富含振动的力矩进行短期预测。该网络通过非对称的确定性与概率性头部预测频谱分解后的力矩，将高频残差建模为可学习的条件分布。该模型进一步融合频率感知机制，通过可学习的滤波自适应增强输入频谱，并对输出施加频段先验约束。我们在大型开源机器人数据集上预训练该网络，并将学习到的本体感知-力矩表征迁移至下游任务。基于六自由度液压机械臂的真实打磨挖掘数据，在延迟估计设定下，该模型在高频段的估计性能优于基线估计与预测方法，在低频段同样保持竞争力。迁移学习进一步提升了性能，表明大规模预训练与迁移学习在机器人力矩估计领域具有潜力。代码与数据将在论文录用后公开。

title: OVAL: Open-Vocabulary Augmented Memory Model for Lifelong Object Goal Navigation
summary: Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) refers to an agent navigating to an object in an unseen environment, which is an ability often required in the accomplishment of complex tasks. While existing methods demonstrate proficiency in isolated single object navigation, their limitations emerge in the restricted applicability of lifelong memory representations, which ultimately hinders effective navigation toward continual targets over extended periods. To address this problem, we propose OVAL, a novel lifelong open-vocabulary memory framework, which enables efficient and precise execution of long-term navigation in semantically open tasks. Within this framework, we introduce memory descriptors to facilitate structured management of the memory model. Additionally, we propose a novel probability-based exploration strategy, utilizing a multi-value frontier scoring to enhance lifelong exploration efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed system.
tldr: This paper proposes OVAL, a lifelong open-vocabulary memory framework for Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav), aiming to enable efficient navigation towards continual targets over long periods in unseen environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 OVAL，一种用于目标导航（ObjectNav）的终身开放词汇记忆框架，旨在在未知环境中长期高效地导航至连续目标。
summary_zh: 物体目标导航（ObjectNav）是指智能体在未见环境中导航至目标物体的能力，这是完成复杂任务时经常需要的技能。现有方法虽然在单一物体导航任务中表现出色，但其终身记忆表征的适用范围存在局限，这最终阻碍了智能体在长时间内对连续目标进行有效导航。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OVAL——一种新颖的终身开放词汇记忆框架，该框架能够在语义开放任务中实现高效且精确的长期导航。在此框架中，我们引入了记忆描述符来促进记忆模型的结构化管理。此外，我们还提出了一种基于概率的新型探索策略，通过多值边界评分机制来提升终身探索效率。大量实验验证了该系统的效率与鲁棒性。

title: Evolving the Complete Muscle: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-design for Musculoskeletal Locomotion
summary: Musculoskeletal robots offer intrinsic compliance and flexibility, providing a promising paradigm for versatile locomotion. However, existing research typically relies on models with fixed muscle physiological parameters. This static physical setting fails to accommodate the diverse dynamic demands of complex tasks, inherently limiting the robot's performance upper bound. In this work, we focus on the morphology and control co-design of musculoskeletal systems. Unlike previous studies that optimize single physiological attributes such as stiffness, we introduce a Complete Musculoskeletal Morphological Evolution Space that simultaneously evolves muscle strength, velocity, and stiffness. To overcome the exponential expansion of the exploration space caused by this comprehensive evolution, we propose Spectral Design Evolution (SDE), a high-efficiency co-optimization framework. By integrating a bilateral symmetry prior with Principal Component Analysis (PCA), SDE projects complex muscle parameters onto a low-dimensional spectral manifold, enabling efficient morphological exploration. Evaluated on the MyoSuite framework across four tasks (Walk, Stair, Hilly, and Rough terrains), our method demonstrates superior learning efficiency and locomotion stability compared to fixed-morphology and standard evolutionary baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes an efficient co-design method to evolve muscle strength, velocity, and stiffness for musculoskeletal robots, using spectral manifold projection for morphology-control optimization, demonstrating superior performance in locomotion tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种高效的协同设计方法，用于同时进化骨骼肌机器人的肌肉力量、速度和刚度，利用谱流形投影进行形态-控制优化，在多个地形任务中展现出优越的移动性能。
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼机器人具备固有的柔顺性与灵活性，为多场景运动提供了极具潜力的实现范式。然而，现有研究通常依赖固定肌肉生理参数的模型，这种静态的物理设定难以适应复杂任务多样化的动态需求，本质上限制了机器人的性能上限。本研究聚焦于肌肉骨骼系统的形态与控制协同设计。与以往仅优化刚度等单一生理属性的研究不同，本文提出了一个完整的肌肉骨骼形态进化空间，能够同时进化肌肉力量、速度与刚度。为应对全面进化带来的探索空间指数级扩张问题，我们提出了高效协同优化框架——谱系设计进化（SDE）。该方法通过将双侧对称先验与主成分分析相结合，将复杂肌肉参数映射到低维谱流形上，实现了高效的形态探索。在MyoSuite框架下对四种任务（平地行走、楼梯、坡道与崎岖地形）的评估表明，相较于固定形态和标准进化基线方法，本方法展现出更优的学习效率和运动稳定性。

title: VULCAN: Vision-Language-Model Enhanced Multi-Agent Cooperative Navigation for Indoor Fire-Disaster Response
summary: Indoor fire disasters pose severe challenges to autonomous search and rescue due to dense smoke, high temperatures, and dynamically evolving indoor environments. In such time-critical scenarios, multi-agent cooperative navigation is particularly useful, as it enables faster and broader exploration than single-agent approaches. However, existing multi-agent navigation systems are primarily vision-based and designed for benign indoor settings, leading to significant performance degradation under fire-driven dynamic conditions. In this paper, we present VULCAN, a multi-agent cooperative navigation framework based on multi-modal perception and vision-language models (VLMs), tailored for indoor fire disaster response. We extend the Habitat-Matterport3D benchmark by simulating physically realistic fire scenarios, including smoke diffusion, thermal hazards, and sensor degradation. We evaluate representative multi-agent cooperative navigation baselines under both normal and fire-driven environments. Our results reveal critical failure modes of existing methods in fire scenarios and underscore the necessity of robust perception and hazard-aware planning for reliable multi-agent search and rescue.
tldr: This paper introduces VULCAN, a multi-agent cooperative navigation framework for indoor fire disaster response, utilizing multi-modal perception and vision-language models. It extends Habitat-Matterport3D with fire simulations to evaluate baseline methods, highlighting their failure modes and the need for robust perception and hazard-aware planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VULCAN框架，一种用于室内火灾灾害响应的多智能体协作导航系统，基于多模态感知和视觉-语言模型。它扩展了Habitat-Matterport3D基准，通过火灾模拟评估现有方法，揭示了其在火灾场景下的关键故障模式，并强调了鲁棒感知和危险感知规划的必要性。
summary_zh: 室内火灾事故因其浓烟、高温及动态变化的室内环境，对自主搜索与救援构成严峻挑战。在此类时间紧迫的场景中，多智能体协同导航展现出显著优势，相比单智能体方案能够实现更快速、更广泛的环境探索。然而，现有的多智能体导航系统主要基于视觉感知，并针对常规室内环境设计，在火灾引发的动态条件下性能严重下降。本文提出VULCAN——一种基于多模态感知与视觉语言模型的多智能体协同导航框架，专门用于室内火灾应急响应。我们通过模拟物理真实的火灾场景（包括烟雾扩散、热危害及传感器性能衰减）拓展了Habitat-Matterport3D基准测试平台。在常规与火灾驱动环境下，我们对代表性多智能体协同导航基线方法进行了系统性评估。实验结果表明，现有方法在火灾场景中存在关键失效模式，并凸显了稳健感知与风险感知规划对于可靠多智能体搜索救援的必要性。

title: Habitat-GS: A High-Fidelity Navigation Simulator with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Training embodied AI agents depends critically on the visual fidelity of simulation environments and the ability to model dynamic humans. Current simulators rely on mesh-based rasterization with limited visual realism, and their support for dynamic human avatars, where available, is constrained to mesh representations, hindering agent generalization to human-populated real-world scenarios. We present Habitat-GS, a navigation-centric embodied AI simulator extended from Habitat-Sim that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting scene rendering and drivable gaussian avatars while maintaining full compatibility with the Habitat ecosystem. Our system implements a 3DGS renderer for real-time photorealistic rendering and supports scalable 3DGS asset import from diverse sources. For dynamic human modeling, we introduce a gaussian avatar module that enables each avatar to simultaneously serve as a photorealistic visual entity and an effective navigation obstacle, allowing agents to learn human-aware behaviors in realistic settings. Experiments on point-goal navigation demonstrate that agents trained on 3DGS scenes achieve stronger cross-domain generalization, with mixed-domain training being the most effective strategy. Evaluations on avatar-aware navigation further confirm that gaussian avatars enable effective human-aware navigation. Finally, performance benchmarks validate the system's scalability across varying scene complexity and avatar counts.
tldr: This paper introduces Habitat-GS, a high-fidelity navigation simulator that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting for photorealistic rendering and dynamic human avatars, showing improved agent generalization in point-goal and avatar-aware navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Habitat-GS，一个采用3D高斯泼溅技术实现高保真度渲染和动态人体化身的导航仿真器，实验表明其在点到点导航和具身智能体导航任务中能提升智能体的泛化能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：
训练具身智能体高度依赖于仿真环境的视觉逼真度以及对动态人体建模的能力。当前仿真器普遍采用基于网格的光栅化渲染技术，其视觉真实感有限；即使在支持动态人体化身的情况下，也仅局限于网格表示形式，这制约了智能体在现实人类场景中的泛化能力。本文提出Habitat-GS——一个以导航为核心的具身智能仿真器，该系统基于Habitat-Sim框架拓展而来，在完全兼容Habitat生态系统的同时，集成了3D高斯溅射场景渲染与可驱动高斯化身功能。我们实现了支持实时高真实感渲染的3DGS渲染器，并能从多源数据高效导入可扩展的3DGS资产。在动态人体建模方面，我们引入高斯化身模块，使每个化身既能作为高真实度的视觉实体，又能充当有效的导航障碍物，从而让智能体在逼真场景中学习人类感知行为。通过点目标导航实验验证，在3DGS场景中训练的智能体展现出更强的跨领域泛化能力，其中混合领域训练策略效果最为显著。化身感知导航评估进一步证实高斯化身能实现有效的人类感知导航。最后，性能基准测试验证了系统在不同场景复杂度与化身数量下的可扩展性。

title: Scalable Trajectory Generation for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
summary: Robots deployed in unstructured environments must coordinate whole-body motion -- simultaneously moving a mobile base and arm -- to interact with the physical world. This coupled mobility and dexterity yields a state space that grows combinatorially with scene and object diversity, demanding datasets far larger than those sufficient for fixed-base manipulation. Yet existing acquisition methods, including teleoperation and planning, are either labor-intensive or computationally prohibitive at scale. The core bottleneck is the lack of a scalable pipeline for generating large-scale, physically valid, coordinated trajectory data across diverse embodiments and environments. Here we introduce AutoMoMa, a GPU-accelerated framework that unifies AKR modeling, which consolidates base, arm, and object kinematics into a single chain, with parallelized trajectory optimization. AutoMoMa achieves 5,000 episodes per GPU-hour (over $80\times$ faster than CPU-based baselines), producing a dataset of over 500k physically valid trajectories spanning 330 scenes, diverse articulated objects, and multiple robot embodiments. Prior datasets were forced to compromise on scale, diversity, or kinematic fidelity; AutoMoMa addresses all three simultaneously. Training downstream IL policies further reveals that even a single articulated-object task requires tens of thousands of demonstrations for SOTA methods to reach $\approx 80\%$ success, confirming that data scarcity -- not algorithmic limitations -- has been the binding constraint. AutoMoMa thus bridges high-performance planning and reliable IL-based control, providing the infrastructure previously missing for coordinated mobile manipulation research. By making large-scale, kinematically valid training data practical, AutoMoMa showcases generalizable whole-body robot policies capable of operating in the diverse, unstructured settings of the real world.
tldr: AutoMoMa is a GPU-accelerated framework that efficiently generates large-scale, physically valid trajectory data for training whole-body mobile manipulation policies, addressing a critical data scarcity bottleneck.
tldr_zh: AutoMoMa 是一个 GPU 加速框架，用于高效生成大规模、物理有效的全身移动操作轨迹数据，解决了数据稀缺的关键瓶颈。
summary_zh: 部署在非结构化环境中的机器人必须协调全身运动——同时移动移动基座与机械臂——以与物理世界交互。这种移动性与灵巧性的耦合产生了随场景和物体多样性呈组合增长的状态空间，所需的数据集规模远超过固定基座操作任务的需求。然而现有的数据采集方法，包括遥操作和运动规划，要么劳动密集型，要么在大规模应用时计算成本过高。核心瓶颈在于缺乏一个可扩展的流水线，能够跨不同机器人构型与环境生成大规模、物理有效的协调轨迹数据。本文提出AutoMoMa：一个GPU加速框架，该框架将AKR建模（将基座、机械臂和物体运动学整合为单一运动链）与并行化轨迹优化相统一。AutoMoMa实现了每GPU小时5,000条轨迹的生成效率（相比基于CPU的基线方法加速超80倍），产生了包含超过50万条物理有效轨迹的数据集，涵盖330个场景、多种关节化物体及多类机器人构型。以往的数据集不得不在规模、多样性或运动学保真度上做出妥协，而AutoMoMa同时解决了这三个问题。训练下游模仿学习策略进一步表明，即使是单个关节物体操作任务，也需数万条示范数据才能使前沿方法达到约80%的成功率，这证实了数据稀缺性（而非算法限制）一直是关键制约因素。AutoMoMa由此连接了高性能规划与基于模仿学习的可靠控制，为协调移动操作研究提供了先前缺失的基础设施。通过使大规模、运动学有效的训练数据生成变得可行，AutoMoMa展示了可泛化的全身机器人策略能够胜任现实世界中多样化、非结构化的操作场景。

title: Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation using Offline Reinforcement Learning on Sub-optimal Controllers
summary: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) of articulated objects, such as opening doors, drawers, and cupboards, demands simultaneous, whole-body coordination between a robot's base and arms. Classical whole-body controllers (WBCs) can solve such problems via hierarchical optimization, but require extensive hand-tuned optimization and remain brittle. Learning-based methods, on the other hand, show strong generalization capabilities but typically rely on expensive whole-body teleoperation data or heavy reward engineering. We observe that even a sub-optimal WBC is a powerful structural prior: it can be used to collect data in a constrained, task-relevant region of the state-action space, and its behavior can still be improved upon using offline reinforcement learning. Building on this, we propose WHOLE-MoMa, a two-stage pipeline that first generates diverse demonstrations by randomizing a lightweight WBC, and then applies offline RL to identify and stitch together improved behaviors via a reward signal. To support the expressive action-chunked diffusion policies needed for complex coordination tasks, we extend offline implicit Q-learning with Q-chunking for chunk-level critic evaluation and advantage-weighted policy extraction. On three tasks of increasing difficulty using a TIAGo++ mobile manipulator in simulation, WHOLE-MoMa significantly outperforms WBC, behavior cloning, and several offline RL baselines. Policies transfer directly to the real robot without finetuning, achieving 80% success in bimanual drawer manipulation and 68% in simultaneous cupboard opening and object placement, all without any teleoperated or real-world training data.
tldr: The paper proposes WHOLE-MoMa, a method for whole-body mobile manipulation using offline RL on sub-optimal whole-body controller data, which transfers to a real TIAGo++ robot without real-world training.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出WHOLE-MoMa方法，利用离线强化学习对次优全身控制器数据进行改进，实现移动操作，并可直接在真实TIAGo++机器人上部署，无需真实世界训练数据。
summary_zh: 移动操作铰接物体（如开门、抽屉和柜子）需要机器人的基座与手臂进行同步的整体协调。经典的整体控制器通过分层优化能够解决此类问题，但需要大量手动调优且往往表现脆弱。另一方面，基于学习的方法展现出强大的泛化能力，但通常依赖昂贵的整体遥操作数据或复杂的奖励工程。我们观察到，即使是次优的整体控制器也具备强大的结构先验作用：它可用于在状态-动作空间的任务相关约束区域内收集数据，并仍可通过离线强化学习对其行为进行改进。基于此，我们提出WHOLE-MoMa——一种两阶段框架：首先通过随机化轻量级整体控制器生成多样化演示数据，随后应用离线强化学习，通过奖励信号识别并整合优化后的行为。为支持复杂协调任务所需的表达能力强的动作分块扩散策略，我们扩展了离线隐式Q学习算法，提出Q分块机制以实现分块级价值评估和优势加权策略提取。在仿真环境中使用TIAGo++移动操作器对三个难度递增的任务进行测试，WHOLE-MoMa显著优于整体控制器、行为克隆及多种离线强化学习基线方法。策略可直接迁移至真实机器人而无需微调，在双手抽屉操作任务中达到80%成功率，在同步柜门开启与物体放置任务中达到68%成功率，且全程未使用任何遥操作或真实世界训练数据。

title: DeCoNav: Dialog enhanced Long-Horizon Collaborative Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Long-horizon collaborative vision-language navigation (VLN) is critical for multi-robot systems to accomplish complex tasks beyond the capability of a single agent. CoNavBench takes a first step by introducing the first collaborative long-horizon VLN benchmark with relay-style multi-robot tasks, a collaboration taxonomy, along with graph-grounded generation and evaluation to model handoffs and rendezvous in shared environments. However, existing benchmarks and evaluations often do not enforce strictly synchronized dual-robot rollout on a shared world timeline, and they typically rely on static coordination policies that cannot adapt when new cross-agent evidence emerges. We present Dialog enhanced Long-Horizon Collaborative Vision-Language Navigation (DeCoNav), a decentralized framework that couples event-triggered dialogue with dynamic task allocation and replanning for real-time, adaptive coordination. In DeCoNav, robots exchange compact semantic states via dialogue without a central controller. When informative events such as new evidence, uncertainty, or conflicts arise, dialogue is triggered to dynamically reassign subgoals and replan under synchronized execution. Implemented in DeCoNavBench with 1,213 tasks across 176 HM3D scenes, DeCoNav improves the both-success rate (BSR) by 69.2%, demonstrating the effectiveness of dialogue-driven, dynamically reallocated planning for multi-robot collaboration.
tldr: Proposes DeCoNav, a decentralized framework for multi-robot collaborative navigation that uses event-triggered dialogue for dynamic task reallocation and replanning, improving success rates.
tldr_zh: 提出了DeCoNav，一个用于多机器人协作导航的分散式框架，利用事件触发的对话进行动态任务重新分配和重规划，提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：长视野协作视觉语言导航对多机器人系统完成超越单个智能体能力的复杂任务至关重要。CoNavBench通过引入首个具备接力式多机器人任务、协作分类法及图基准生成与评估机制的长视野协作视觉语言导航基准，为共享环境中的交接与会合建模迈出了重要一步。然而现有基准与评估方法通常未能在共享世界时间线上严格执行双机器人同步推演，且普遍依赖静态协调策略，无法在跨智能体出现新证据时动态调整。我们提出对话增强型长视野协作视觉语言导航——一种将事件触发对话与动态任务分配及重规划耦合的去中心化框架，能够实现实时自适应协调。在该框架中，机器人无需中央控制器即可通过对话交换精简的语义状态。当出现新证据、不确定性或冲突等关键事件时，系统将触发对话机制，在执行同步过程中动态重新分配子目标并实施重规划。通过在包含176个HM3D场景的1,213项任务中构建的DeCoNavBench测试表明，该框架将双机器人成功率提升了69.2%，证实了对话驱动、动态重分配规划策略在多机器人协作中的有效性。

title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution
summary: In many robotic tasks, agents must traverse a sequence of spatial regions to complete a mission. Such problems are inherently mixed discrete-continuous: a high-level action sequence and a physically feasible continuous trajectory. The resulting trajectory and action sequence must also satisfy problem constraints such as deadlines, time windows, and velocity or acceleration limits. While hybrid temporal planners attempt to address this challenge, they typically model motion using linear (first-order) dynamics, which cannot guarantee that the resulting plan respects the robot's true physical constraints. Consequently, even when the high-level action sequence is fixed, producing a dynamically feasible trajectory becomes a bi-level optimization problem. We address this problem via reinforcement learning in continuous space. We define a Markov Decision Process that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner. Our results show that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.
tldr: The paper proposes a reinforcement learning method that refines high-level hybrid plans, generated with first-order dynamics, to ensure they satisfy second-order physical dynamics constraints for robot execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种强化学习方法，用于细化基于一阶动力学生成的高层混合规划，确保其满足机器人执行所需的二阶物理动力学约束。
summary_zh: 在许多机器人任务中，智能体必须穿越一系列空间区域以完成使命。这类问题本质上是混合离散-连续的：既涉及高层动作序列，又需考虑物理上可行的连续轨迹。最终生成的轨迹与动作序列还必须满足任务约束，如截止时间、时间窗口以及速度或加速度限制。尽管混合时序规划器尝试解决这一挑战，但通常采用线性（一阶）动力学模型进行运动建模，无法保证所得方案符合机器人的真实物理约束。因此，即使高层动作序列已确定，生成动态可行轨迹仍会转化为一个双层优化问题。我们通过连续空间中的强化学习来解决这一问题。我们定义了一个显式包含解析二阶约束的马尔可夫决策过程，并利用该过程对混合规划器生成的一阶方案进行优化。实验结果表明，该方法能可靠地恢复物理可行性，有效弥合规划器初始一阶轨迹与实际执行所需动力学特性之间的差距。

title: HazardArena: Evaluating Semantic Safety in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich world knowledge from vision-language backbones and acquire executable skills via action demonstrations. However, existing evaluations largely focus on action execution success, leaving action policies loosely coupled with visual-linguistic semantics. This decoupling exposes a systematic vulnerability whereby correct action execution may induce unsafe outcomes under semantic risk. To expose this vulnerability, we introduce HazardArena, a benchmark designed to evaluate semantic safety in VLAs under controlled yet risk-bearing contexts. HazardArena is constructed from safe/unsafe twin scenarios that share matched objects, layouts, and action requirements, differing only in the semantic context that determines whether an action is unsafe. We find that VLA models trained exclusively on safe scenarios often fail to behave safely when evaluated in their corresponding unsafe counterparts. HazardArena includes over 2,000 assets and 40 risk-sensitive tasks spanning 7 real-world risk categories grounded in established robotic safety standards. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a training-free Safety Option Layer that constrains action execution using semantic attributes or a vision-language judge, substantially reducing unsafe behaviors with minimal impact on task performance. We hope that HazardArena highlights the need to rethink how semantic safety is evaluated and enforced in VLAs as they scale toward real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces HazardArena, a benchmark for evaluating semantic safety in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models within risk-sensitive robotic contexts, revealing a vulnerability where models fail to behave safely and proposing a mitigation method.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HazardArena，一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型在风险敏感机器人上下文中的语义安全性的基准，揭示了模型在语义风险下可能执行不安全行为的系统性漏洞，并提出了一种无训练的缓解方法。
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型继承了视觉语言主干网络丰富的世界知识，并通过动作演示习得了可执行技能。然而，现有评估多聚焦于动作执行成功率，导致动作策略与视觉-语言语义之间的耦合较为松散。这种脱钩暴露了系统性的脆弱性：即使动作执行正确，也可能在语义风险下引发不安全后果。为揭示这一脆弱性，我们提出了HazardArena——一个在受控且具风险的情境下评估VLA模型语义安全性的基准测试平台。该平台基于安全/不安全孪生场景构建，这些场景在物体、布局与动作要求上完全一致，仅通过决定动作是否安全的语义情境进行区分。研究发现，仅通过安全场景训练的VLA模型，在对应不安全场景的评估中往往无法做出安全响应。HazardArena包含超过2000个资产与40个风险敏感任务，涵盖基于成熟机器人安全标准确立的7个现实世界风险类别。为缓解该脆弱性，我们提出了一种免训练的安全选项层，通过语义属性或视觉语言判别器约束动作执行，在保证任务性能影响最小的前提下显著减少了不安全行为。我们期望HazardArena能够引发学界对VLA模型规模化落地过程中语义安全评估与保障机制的重新思考。

title: Uncertainty Guided Exploratory Trajectory Optimization for Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
summary: Trajectory optimization depends heavily on initialization. In particular, sampling-based approaches are highly sensitive to initial solutions, and limited exploration frequently leads them to converge to local minima in complex environments. We present Uncertainty Guided Exploratory Trajectory Optimization (UGE-TO), a trajectory optimization algorithm that generates well-separated samples to achieve a better coverage of the configuration space. UGE-TO represents trajectories as probability distributions induced by uncertainty ellipsoids. Unlike sampling-based approaches that explore only in the action space, this representation captures the effects of both system dynamics and action selection. By incorporating the impact of dynamics, in addition to the action space, into our distributions, our method enhances trajectory diversity by enforcing distributional separation via the Hellinger distance between them. It enables a systematic exploration of the configuration space and improves robustness against local minima. Further, we present UGE-MPC, which integrates UGE-TO into sampling-based model predictive controller methods. Experiments demonstrate that UGE-MPC achieves higher exploration and faster convergence in trajectory optimization compared to baselines under the same sampling budget, achieving 72.1% faster convergence in obstacle-free environments and 66% faster convergence with a 6.7% higher success rate in the cluttered environment compared to the best-performing baseline. Additionally, we validate the approach through a range of simulation scenarios and real-world experiments. Our results indicate that UGE-MPC has higher success rates and faster convergence, especially in environments that demand significant deviations from nominal trajectories to avoid failures. The project and code are available at https://ogpoyrazoglu.github.io/cuniform_sampling/.
tldr: This paper presents Uncertainty Guided Exploratory Trajectory Optimization (UGE-TO), a method for sampling-based trajectory optimization that uses uncertainty ellipsoids to generate diverse trajectories, and integrates it into a Model Predictive Control (UGE-MPC) framework. It improves exploration, convergence speed, and success rates in complex and cluttered environments, validated through simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了不确定性引导的探索性轨迹优化方法（UGE-TO），该方法利用不确定性椭球在采样式轨迹优化中生成多样化的轨迹，并将其集成到模型预测控制（UGE-MPC）框架中。该方法提高了在复杂和杂乱环境中的探索能力、收敛速度和成功率，并通过仿真和真实世界实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 轨迹优化在很大程度上依赖于初始条件。特别是基于采样的方法对初始解极为敏感，有限的探索能力常使其在复杂环境中收敛至局部极小值。本文提出不确定性引导探索式轨迹优化（UGE-TO）算法，该算法通过生成高度分离的采样点来实现对构型空间更充分的覆盖。UGE-TO将轨迹表示为不确定性椭球诱导的概率分布。与仅在动作空间进行探索的基于采样的方法不同，该表示形式同时捕捉了系统动力学与动作选择的影响。通过将动力学影响与动作空间共同纳入分布建模，我们的方法利用分布间的Hellinger距离强制实现分布分离，从而增强轨迹多样性。这实现了对构型空间的系统性探索，并提升了对局部极小值的鲁棒性。进一步地，我们提出UGE-MPC框架，将UGE-TO集成至基于采样的模型预测控制器方法中。实验表明，在相同采样预算下，UGE-MPC相比基线方法在轨迹优化中实现了更高的探索效率与更快的收敛速度：在无障碍环境中收敛速度提升72.1%，在复杂障碍环境中收敛速度提升66%且成功率提高6.7%。此外，我们通过一系列仿真场景与真实世界实验验证了该方法的有效性。结果表明UGE-MPC具有更高的成功率和更快的收敛速度，特别是在需要大幅偏离标称轨迹以避免失败的场景中表现尤为突出。项目与代码开源地址：https://ogpoyrazoglu.github.io/cuniform_sampling/。

title: Dynamic Modeling and Robust Gait Optimization of a Compliant Worm Robot
summary: Worm-inspired robots provide an effective locomotion strategy for constrained environments by combining cyclic body deformation with alternating anchoring. For compliant robots, however, the interaction between deformable anchoring structures and the environment makes predictive modeling and deployable gait optimization challenging. This paper presents an experimentally grounded modeling and optimization framework for a compliant worm robot capable of traversing corrugated pipes. First, a hybrid dynamic locomotion model is derived, in which the robot motion is represented by continuous dynamics within a corrugation groove and discrete switching of anchoring positions between adjacent grooves. A slack-aware actuation model is further introduced to map the commanded gait input to the realized body-length change, and an energy model is developed based on physics and calibrated with empirical power measurement. Based on these models, a multi-objective gait optimization problem is formulated to maximize average speed while minimizing average power. To reduce the fragility of nominal boundary-seeking solutions, a kinematic robustness margin is introduced into the anchoring-transition conditions, leading to a margin-based robust gait optimization framework. Experimental results show that the proposed framework captures the dominant locomotion and energy-consumption behavior of the robot over the tested conditions, and enables robust gait optimization for achieving speed-power trade-off.
tldr: This paper presents a modeling and robust gait optimization framework for a compliant, worm-inspired robot, using hybrid dynamics and a margin-based approach to improve locomotion and energy efficiency in corrugated pipes.
tldr_zh: 本文为一种蠕虫式柔顺机器人提出了一个建模和鲁棒步态优化框架，利用混合动力学和基于裕度的方法，提高了其在波纹管道中的运动效率和能量表现。
summary_zh: 蠕虫仿生机器人为受限环境下的运动提供了一种有效策略，其通过循环的形体形变与交替锚定相结合来实现移动。然而对于柔性机器人而言，可变形锚定结构与环境的相互作用使得预测性建模与可部署步态优化面临挑战。本文提出了一种基于实验的建模与优化框架，用于实现柔性蠕虫机器人在波纹管道内的行进。首先推导了混合动力学运动模型，其中机器人运动被描述为在波纹凹槽内的连续动态过程以及在相邻凹槽间锚定点离散切换的过程。进一步引入松弛感知驱动模型，将指令步态输入映射至实际体长变化，并基于物理原理建立能量模型，通过实测功率数据对其进行校准。基于这些模型，构建了多目标步态优化问题，以在最大化平均速度的同时最小化平均功率。为降低传统边界寻优解的脆弱性，在锚定切换条件中引入了运动学鲁棒裕度，从而形成基于裕度的鲁棒步态优化框架。实验结果表明，所提框架在测试条件下能够准确捕捉机器人主导的运动与能耗特性，并可通过鲁棒步态优化实现速度与功率的权衡。

title: ReefMapGS: Enabling Large-Scale Underwater Reconstruction by Closing the Loop Between Multimodal SLAM and Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a powerful visual representation, providing high-quality and efficient 3D scene reconstruction, but it is crucially dependent on accurate camera poses typically obtained from computationally intensive processes like structure-from-motion that are unsuitable for field robot applications. However, in these domains, multimodal sensor data from acoustic, inertial, pressure, and visual sensors are available and suitable for pose-graph optimization-based SLAM methods that can estimate the vehicle's trajectory and thus our needed camera poses while providing uncertainty. We propose a 3DGS-based incremental reconstruction framework, ReefMapGS, that builds an initial model from a high certainty region and progressively expands to incorporate the whole scene. We reconstruct the scene incrementally by interleaving local tracking of new image observations with optimization of the underlying 3DGS scene. These refined poses are integrated back into the pose-graph to globally optimize the whole trajectory. We show COLMAP-free 3D reconstruction of two underwater reef sites with complex geometry as well as more accurate global pose estimation of our AUV over survey trajectories spanning up to 700 m.
tldr: Proposes ReefMapGS, a system for large-scale underwater reconstruction by closing the loop between multimodal SLAM (acoustic, inertial, pressure, visual) and Gaussian Splatting, enabling incremental 3D scene building on an AUV.
tldr_zh: 提出ReefMapGS，一个通过结合多模态SLAM（声学、惯性、压力、视觉）与高斯泼溅来闭合环路，实现大规模水下重建的系统，可在自主水下航行器上增量构建3D场景。
summary_zh: 3D高斯喷洒是一种强大的视觉表示方法，能够实现高质量、高效率的三维场景重建，但其性能关键依赖于精确的相机位姿，这些位姿通常需通过计算密集型流程（如运动恢复结构）获取，而此类方法不适用于野外机器人应用。然而在这些领域中，来自声学、惯性、压力及视觉传感器的多模态数据是可获取的，且适合采用基于位姿图优化的SLAM方法——这类方法既能估计载具运动轨迹以提供所需相机位姿，同时也能给出位姿的不确定性度量。我们提出了基于3DGS的增量式重建框架ReefMapGS，该框架首先从高置信度区域构建初始模型，并逐步扩展以融合完整场景。我们通过交替执行新图像观测的局部追踪与底层3DGS场景的优化来实现场景的增量重建，优化后的位姿会重新整合到位姿图中，以实现整体轨迹的全局优化。实验表明，本方法在两个具有复杂几何结构的水下珊瑚礁区域实现了无需COLMAP的三维重建，并在长达700米的勘测轨迹上为自主水下航行器提供了更精确的全局位姿估计。

title: Bipedal-Walking-Dynamics Model on Granular Terrains
summary: Bipeds have demonstrated high agility and mobility in unstructured environments such as sand. The yielding of such granular media brings significant sinkage and slip of the bipedal feet, leading to uncertainty and instability of walking locomotion. We present a new dynamics-modeling approach to capture and predict bipedal-walking locomotion on granular media. A dynamic foot-terrain interaction model is integrated to compute the ground reaction force (GRF). The proposed granular dynamic model has three additional degree-of-freedom (DoF) to estimate foot sinkage and slip that are critical to capturing robot-walking kinematics and kinetics such as cost of transport (CoT). Using the new model, we analyze bipedal kinetics, CoT, and foot-terrain rolling and intrusion affects. Experiments are conducted using a biped robotic walker on sand to validate the proposed dynamic model with robot-gait profiles, media-intrusion prediction, and GRF estimations. This new dynamics model can further serve as an enabling tool for locomotion control and optimization of bipedal robots to efficiently walk on granular terrains.
tldr: The paper presents a new dynamic model for bipedal robot walking on granular terrains like sand, incorporating foot sinkage and slip to analyze kinetics and cost of transport, with experimental validation on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的双足机器人行走在颗粒状地形（如沙地）上的动力学模型，该模型结合了足部下陷和滑移，用于分析运动动力学和运输成本，并在物理机器人上进行了实验验证。
summary_zh: 双足机器人在非结构化环境（如沙地）中展现出高度的敏捷性和移动性。这类颗粒介质的可屈服性会导致双足脚部显著下沉和滑移，从而引发行走运动的不确定性和不稳定性。我们提出一种新的动力学建模方法，用以捕捉和预测双足在颗粒介质上的行走运动。通过集成动态足-地形交互模型来计算地面反作用力（GRF）。所提出的颗粒动力学模型包含三个额外的自由度（DoF），用于估计脚部下沉和滑移——这对于捕捉机器人行走运动学与动力学（如运输成本CoT）至关重要。基于新模型，我们分析了双足动力学、运输成本以及足-地形滚动与侵入效应。研究通过在沙地上使用双足机器人行走器进行实验，验证了所提出的动力学模型在机器人步态分析、介质侵入预测和地面反作用力估算方面的有效性。该动力学模型可进一步作为双足机器人运动控制与优化的关键工具，以提升其在颗粒地形上的高效行走能力。

title: Agentic LLM Reasoning in a Self-Driving Laboratory for Air-Sensitive Lithium Halide Spinel Conductors
summary: Self-driving laboratories promise to accelerate materials discovery. Yet current automated solid-state synthesis platforms are limited to ambient conditions, thereby precluding their use for air-sensitive materials. Here, we present A-Lab for Glovebox Powder Solid-state Synthesis (A-Lab GPSS), a robotic platform capable of synthesizing and characterizing air-sensitive inorganic materials under strict air-free conditions. By integrating an agentic AI framework into the A-Lab GPSS platform, we structure autonomous experimental design through abductive and inductive reasoning. We deploy this platform to explore the vast compositional space of lithium halide spinel solid-state ionic conductors. Across a synthesis campaign comprising 352 samples with diverse compositions, the system explores a broad chemical space, experimentally realizing 72% of the 171 possible pairwise combinations among the 19 metals considered in this study. Over the course of the campaign, the fraction of compositions exhibiting both good ionic conductivity (> 0.05 mS/cm) and high halide spinel phase purity increases from 1.33% in the first 75 agent-proposed samples to 5.33% in the final 75. Furthermore, by inspecting the AI's reasoning processes, we reveal distinct yet complementary discovery strategies: abductive reasoning interrogates abnormal observations within already explored regions, whereas inductive reasoning expands the search into broader, previously unvisited chemical space. This work establishes a scalable platform for the autonomous discovery of complex, air-sensitive solid-state materials.
tldr: The paper introduces A-Lab GPSS, a robotic platform for autonomously synthesizing and characterizing air-sensitive inorganic materials, using an agentic AI framework with abductive and inductive reasoning to explore lithium halide spinel conductors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了A-Lab GPSS，一个用于自主合成和表征空气敏感无机材料的机器人平台，采用具有溯因和归纳推理的智能体AI框架来探索锂卤化物尖晶石导体。
summary_zh: 自主实验室有望加速材料发现。然而当前的自动化固态合成平台仅限于环境条件，无法用于空气敏感材料。本文介绍用于手套箱粉末固态合成的A-Lab（A-Lab GPSS），这是一个能够在严格无氧条件下合成并表征空气敏感无机材料的机器人平台。通过将智能体人工智能框架整合到A-Lab GPSS平台中，我们通过溯因与归纳推理构建了自主实验设计方案。我们运用该平台探索锂卤化物尖晶石固态离子导体的广阔组成空间。在包含352个不同成分样品的合成实验中，系统探索了广泛的化学空间，成功实验合成本研究涉及的19种金属所形成的171种可能二元组合中的72%。在整个实验进程中，同时具备良好离子电导率（> 0.05 mS/cm）和高纯度卤化物尖晶石相的组分比例，从最初75个智能体提议样品的1.33%提升至最后75个样品的5.33%。此外，通过分析人工智能的推理过程，我们揭示了两种相互独立且互为补充的发现策略：溯因推理聚焦于已探索区域的异常观测现象，而归纳推理则将搜索范围拓展至更广阔、未经探索的化学空间。这项工作为自主发现复杂空气敏感固态材料建立了可扩展的研究平台。

title: RMGS-SLAM: Real-time Multi-sensor Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Real-time 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS)-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) in large-scale real-world environments remains challenging, as existing methods often struggle to jointly achieve low-latency pose estimation, 3D Gaussian reconstruction in step with incoming sensor streams, and long-term global consistency. In this paper, we present a tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual (LIV) 3DGS-based SLAM framework for real-time pose estimation and photorealistic mapping in large-scale real-world scenes. The system executes state estimation and 3D Gaussian primitive initialization in parallel with global Gaussian optimization, thereby enabling continuous dense mapping. To improve Gaussian initialization quality and accelerate optimization convergence, we introduce a cascaded strategy that combines feed-forward predictions with voxel-based principal component analysis (voxel-PCA) geometric priors. To enhance global consistency in large scenes, we further perform loop closure directly on the optimized global Gaussian map by estimating loop constraints through Gaussian-based Generalized Iterative Closest Point (GICP) registration, followed by pose-graph optimization. In addition, we collected challenging large-scale looped outdoor SLAM sequences with hardware-synchronized LiDAR-camera-IMU and ground-truth trajectories to support realistic and comprehensive evaluation. Extensive experiments on both public datasets and our dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a strong balance among real-time efficiency, localization accuracy, and rendering quality across diverse and challenging real-world scenes.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time LiDAR-Inertial-Visual 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework for accurate pose estimation and photorealistic mapping in large-scale environments, improving initialization and global consistency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实时的激光雷达-惯性-视觉3D高斯溅射SLAM框架，用于大规模环境中的精确位姿估计和逼真地图构建，改进了初始化和全局一致性。
summary_zh: 在大规模现实环境中实现基于实时3D高斯喷溅（3DGS）的同步定位与建图（SLAM）仍面临诸多挑战，现有方法往往难以同时实现低延迟位姿估计、与传感器输入同步的3D高斯重建以及长期全局一致性。本文提出一种紧耦合的激光雷达-惯性-视觉（LIV）3DGS-SLAM框架，用于大规模现实场景的实时位姿估计与逼真建图。该系统通过并行执行状态估计与3D高斯基元初始化，并配合全局高斯优化，实现了连续稠密建图。为提升高斯初始化质量并加速优化收敛，我们引入一种结合前馈预测与基于体素主成分分析（voxel-PCA）几何先验的级联策略。针对大场景全局一致性问题，我们进一步通过基于高斯模型的广义迭代最近点（GICP）配准估计回环约束，并配合位姿图优化，直接在优化后的全局高斯地图上执行回环检测。此外，我们采集了具有硬件同步的激光雷达-相机-IMU设备及真值轨迹的大规模闭环户外SLAM序列数据集，以支持真实全面的评估。在公开数据集及自建数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在多样化复杂现实场景中，在实时性、定位精度与渲染质量之间实现了良好平衡。

title: Reliability-Guided Depth Fusion for Glare-Resilient Navigation Costmaps
summary: Specular glare on reflective floors and glass surfaces frequently corrupts RGB-D depth measurements, producing holes and spikes that accumulate as persistent phantom obstacles in occupancy-grid costmaps. This paper proposes a glare-resilient costmap construction method based on explicit depth-reliability modeling. A lightweight Depth Reliability Map (DRM) estimator predicts per-pixel measurement trustworthiness under specular interference, and a Reliability-Guided Fusion (RGF) mechanism uses this signal to modulate occupancy updates before corrupted measurements are accumulated into the map. Experiments on a real mobile robotic platform equipped with an Intel RealSense D435 and a Jetson Orin Nano show that the proposed method substantially reduces false obstacle insertion and improves free-space preservation under real reflective-floor and glass-surface conditions, while introducing only modest computational overhead. These results indicate that treating glare as a measurement-reliability problem provides a practical and lightweight solution for improving costmap correctness and navigation robustness in safety-critical indoor environments.
tldr: Proposes a method to reduce phantom obstacles in robotic navigation costmaps caused by specular glare on reflective surfaces, using a lightweight Depth Reliability Map to filter corrupted depth data before map fusion.
tldr_zh: 提出一种方法，通过轻量级深度可靠性地图过滤由镜面眩光导致的损坏深度数据，从而减少机器人导航代价地图中的虚假障碍物。
summary_zh: 摘要：反光地板与玻璃表面的镜面眩光时常会干扰RGB-D深度测量，产生数据空洞与尖峰噪声，这些误差在占据栅格代价地图中不断累积形成持续存在的虚假障碍物。本文提出一种基于显式深度可靠性建模的抗眩光代价地图构建方法。通过轻量化的深度可靠性图（DRM）估计器，在镜面干扰环境下逐像素预测深度测量的可信度，并采用可靠性引导融合（RGF）机制，在受损数据被累积进地图之前，利用该信号对占据概率更新进行调节。在搭载英特尔RealSense D435相机与Jetson Orin Nano平台的实际移动机器人实验中表明，该方法在真实反光地板与玻璃表面场景下，显著减少了虚假障碍物的生成，同时更好地保持了自由空间的可通行性，且仅引入有限的计算开销。这些结果证明，将眩光问题转化为测量可靠性问题来处理，为提升安全关键型室内环境中代价地图的准确性与导航鲁棒性提供了一种实用且轻量化的解决方案。

title: Social Learning Strategies for Evolved Virtual Soft Robots
summary: Optimizing the body and brain of a robot is a coupled challenge: the morphology determines what control strategies are effective, while the control parameters influence how well the morphology performs. This joint optimization can be done through nested loops of evolutionary and learning processes, where the control parameters of each robot are learned independently. However, the control parameters learned by one robot may contain valuable information for others. Thus, we introduce a social learning approach in which robots can exploit optimized parameters from their peers to accelerate their own brain optimization. Within this framework, we systematically investigate how the selection of teachers, deciding which and how many robots to learn from, affects performance, experimenting with virtual soft robots in four tasks and environments. In particular, we study the effect of inheriting experience from morphologically similar robots due to the tightly coupled body and brain in robot optimization. Our results confirm the effectiveness of building on others' experience, as social learning clearly outperforms learning from scratch under equivalent computational budgets. In addition, while the optimal teacher selection strategy remains open, our findings suggest that incorporating knowledge from multiple teachers can yield more consistent and robust improvements.
tldr: The paper introduces a social learning approach to accelerate the brain (controller) optimization of virtual soft robots by allowing them to learn from the optimized parameters of other robots, specifically studying the effect of teacher selection based on morphological similarity.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种社会学习方法，通过让虚拟软体机器人从其他机器人的优化参数中学习来加速其大脑（控制器）优化，并特别研究了基于形态相似性的教师选择策略的影响。
summary_zh: 机器人躯体与大脑的协同优化是一个耦合挑战：形态结构决定了有效控制策略的范畴，而控制参数则影响着形态潜能的发挥程度。此类联合优化可通过进化与学习过程的嵌套循环实现，其中每个机器人的控制参数可被独立学习。然而，单个机器人习得的控制参数可能对其他个体具有重要价值。为此，我们引入一种社会学习机制，使机器人能够利用同伴的优化参数来加速自身大脑优化进程。在此框架下，我们系统研究了教师选择策略——即决定向哪些机器人学习及学习数量——对性能的影响，并在四个任务环境中通过虚拟软体机器人进行实验验证。特别地，由于机器人优化中躯体与大脑的紧密耦合特性，我们重点探究了从形态相似机器人继承经验的效果。实验结果证实了借鉴他人经验的有效性：在相同计算资源条件下，社会学习方法明显优于从零开始的学习模式。此外，尽管最优教师选择策略仍待探索，但我们的研究表明，整合多位教师的知识能够产生更稳定、更鲁棒的优化效果。

title: D-BDM: A Direct and Efficient Boundary-Based Occupancy Grid Mapping Framework for LiDARs
summary: Efficient and scalable 3D occupancy mapping is essential for autonomous robot applications in unknown environments. However, traditional occupancy grid representations suffer from two fundamental limitations. First, explicitly storing all voxels in three-dimensional space leads to prohibitive memory consumption. Second, exhaustive ray casting incurs high update latency. A recent representation alleviate memory demands by maintaining only the voxels on the two-dimensional boundary, yet they still rely on full ray casting updates. This work advances the boundary-based framework with a highly efficient update scheme. We introduce a truncated ray casting strategy that restricts voxel traversal to the exterior of the boundary, which dramatically reduces the number of updated voxels. In addition, we propose a direct boundary update mechanism that removes the need for an auxiliary local 3D occupancy grid, further reducing memory usage and simplifying the map update pipeline. We name our framework as D-BDM. Extensive evaluations on public datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves significantly lower update time and reduced memory consumption compared with the baseline methods, as well as the prior boundary-based approach.
tldr: Proposes D-BDM, a novel boundary-based occupancy grid mapping framework for LiDARs that uses truncated ray casting and a direct boundary update to significantly reduce memory usage and update time, targeting robot applications in unknown environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出D-BDM，一种新颖的基于边界的三维占据栅格建图框架，通过截断光线投射和直接边界更新机制，显著降低了内存占用和更新延迟，面向机器人未知环境探索应用。
summary_zh: 高效且可扩展的3D占据地图构建对于未知环境中的自主机器人应用至关重要。然而，传统的占据栅格表示存在两个根本性局限。首先，显式存储三维空间中的所有体素会导致巨大的内存消耗。其次，详尽的射线投射会产生高昂的更新延迟。近期一种表示方法通过仅维护二维边界上的体素缓解了内存需求，但仍依赖完整的射线投射更新。本研究在边界表示框架基础上提出了一种高效的更新方案。我们引入了一种截断射线投射策略，将体素遍历限制在边界外部区域，从而显著减少需要更新的体素数量。此外，我们提出了一种直接边界更新机制，无需辅助的局部3D占据栅格，进一步降低了内存使用并简化了地图更新流程。我们将该框架命名为D-BDM。在公开数据集上的广泛评估表明，相较于基线方法及现有边界方法，我们的方案在更新时间和内存消耗方面均实现显著降低。

title: A Foot Resistive Force Model for Legged Locomotion on Muddy Terrains
summary: Legged robots face significant challenges in moving and navigating on deformable and highly yielding terrain such as mud. We present a resistive force model for legged foot-mud interactions. The model captures rheological behaviors such as visco-elasticity, thixotropy of the mud suspension and retractive suction. One attractive property of this new model lies in its effective, uniform formulation to provide underlying physical interpretation and accurate resistive force predictions. We further take advantage of the resistive force model to design a new morphing robotic foot for effective and efficient legged locomotion. We conduct extensive experiments to validate the force model, and the results demonstrate that the morphing foot enhances not only the locomotion mobility but also energy-efficiency of walking in mud. The new resistive force model can be further used to develop data-driven simulation and locomotion control of legged robots on muddy terrains.
tldr: This paper presents a novel resistive force model for legged foot-mud interactions and a corresponding morphing robotic foot design, which is validated through experiments to improve legged robot locomotion on muddy terrain.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的有足机器人泥泞地形行走的足部阻力模型及相应的变形足设计，并通过实验验证了其能提高在泥泞地形上的移动能力和能效。
summary_zh: 腿式机器人在泥泞等可变形高屈服强度地形上的移动与导航面临显著挑战。本文提出了一种用于足部-泥浆交互作用的阻力模型。该模型能够捕捉泥浆悬浮液的粘弹性、触变性及回缩吸力等流变特性。该模型的一个突出优势在于其采用统一高效的理论框架，既能提供基础物理解释，又能实现精确的阻力预测。我们进一步利用该阻力模型设计出一种新型变形机械足，以提升腿式机器人在泥泞环境中的运动效能与效率。通过大量实验验证，该力模型表现出良好的准确性，且变形足结构不仅显著提升了运动机动性，还提高了泥泞行走的能效。新型阻力模型可进一步应用于开发数据驱动的腿式机器人泥泞地形仿真与运动控制系统。

title: Complementarity by Construction: A Lie-Group Approach to Solving Quadratic Programs with Linear Complementarity Constraints
summary: Many problems in robotics require reasoning over a mix of continuous dynamics and discrete events, such as making and breaking contact in manipulation and locomotion. These problems are locally well modeled by linear complementarity quadratic programs (LCQPs), an extension to QPs that introduce complementarity constraints. While very expressive, LCQPs are non-convex, and few solvers exist for computing good local solutions for use in planning pipelines. In this work, we observe that complementarity constraints form a Lie group under infinitesimal relaxation, and leverage this structure to perform on-manifold optimization. We introduce a retraction map that is numerically well behaved, and use it to parameterize the constraints so that they are satisfied by construction. The resulting solver avoids many of the classical issues with complementarity constraints. We provide an open-source solver, Marble, that is implemented in C++ with Julia and Python bindings. We demonstrate that Marble is competitive on a suite of benchmark problems, and solves a number of robotics problems where existing approaches fail to converge.
tldr: Proposes a novel solver, Marble, for Linear Complementarity Quadratic Programs (LCQPs) by leveraging their Lie group structure to enable on-manifold optimization, specifically targeting problems with contact dynamics in robotics.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的求解器Marble，通过利用线性互补二次规划的Lie群结构实现流形优化，专门用于解决机器人学中涉及接触动力学的问题。
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人学中的许多问题需要在连续动力学与离散事件之间进行推理，例如操作和运动中的接触建立与脱离。这类问题在局部层面可通过线性互补二次规划（LCQP）得到良好建模，该模型作为二次规划（QP）的扩展引入了互补约束。尽管LCQP具有极强的表达能力，但其本身具有非凸性，且目前鲜有适用于规划流程中高效求解局部最优解的求解器。本研究指出，互补约束在无穷小松弛条件下构成李群结构，并利用这一特性进行流形上的优化。我们提出了一种数值表现良好的收缩映射，并利用该映射对约束进行参数化，从而确保约束在构造过程中自动满足。基于此的求解器有效规避了互补约束带来的诸多经典问题。我们开发了开源求解器Marble，该求解器采用C++实现并提供了Julia与Python语言接口。实验表明，Marble在一系列基准问题上表现优异，并成功解决了多类现有方法无法收敛的机器人学问题。

title: M2HRI: An LLM-Driven Multimodal Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Multi-robot systems hold significant promise for social environments such as homes and hospitals, yet existing multi-robot works treat robots as functionally identical, overlooking how robots individual identity shape user perception and how coordination shapes multi-robot behavior when such individuality is present. To address this, we introduce M2HRI, a multimodal multi-agent framework built on large language models that equips each robot with distinct personality and long-term memory, alongside a coordination mechanism conditioned on these differences. In a controlled user study (n = 105) in a multi-agent human-robot interaction (HRI) scenario, we find that LLM-driven personality traits are significantly distinguishable and enhance interaction quality, long-term memory improves personalization and preference awareness, and centralized coordination significantly reduces overlap while improving overall interaction quality. Together, these results demonstrate that both agent individuality and structured coordination are essential for coherent and socially appropriate multi-agent HRI. Project website and code are available at https://project-m2hri.github.io/.
tldr: M2HRI is an LLM-driven framework for multi-robot social HRI, endowing individual robots with personality and memory, using centralized coordination to improve interaction quality and coherence.
tldr_zh: M2HRI是一个基于LLM的多模态多智能体框架，用于社交人机交互，为每个机器人赋予个性和长期记忆，并通过集中协调来提升交互质量和整体协调性。
summary_zh: 多机器人系统在家庭、医院等社会环境中展现出巨大潜力，但现有研究多将机器人视为功能相同的个体，忽视了机器人个体身份如何影响用户认知，也未探究存在个体差异时协调机制如何塑造多机器人行为。为此，我们提出M2HRI——一个基于大语言模型的多模态多智能体框架，该框架为每个机器人赋予独特个性与长期记忆，并建立了基于差异的协调机制。在多智能体人机交互场景的受控用户研究（n=105）中，我们发现：大语言模型驱动的个性特征具有显著区分度并能提升交互质量；长期记忆增强了系统的个性化与偏好感知能力；集中式协调机制在显著减少交互重叠的同时提升了整体交互质量。这些结果表明，智能体个性与结构化协调对于构建连贯且符合社会规范的多智能体人机交互系统至关重要。项目网站与代码详见https://project-m2hri.github.io/。

title: Dynamic Multi-Robot Task Allocation under Uncertainty and Communication Constraints: A Game-Theoretic Approach
summary: We study dynamic multi-robot task allocation under uncertain task completion, time-window constraints, and incomplete information. Tasks arrive online over a finite horizon and must be completed within specified deadlines, while agents operate from distributed hubs with limited sensing and communication. We model incomplete information through hub-based sensing regions that determine task visibility and a communication graph that governs inter-hub information exchange. Using this framework, we propose Iterative Best Response (IBR), a decentralized policy in which each agent selects the task that maximizes its marginal contribution to the locally observed welfare. We compare IBR against three baselines: Earliest Due Date first (EDD), Hungarian algorithm, and Stochastic Conflict-Based Allocation (SCoBA), on a city-scale package-delivery domain with up to 100 drones and varying task arrival scenarios. Under full and sparse communication, IBR achieves competitive task-completion performance with lower computation time.
tldr: The paper proposes a game-theoretic approach for decentralized multi-robot task allocation under uncertainty and communication constraints, tested on a drone delivery domain.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于博弈论的分散式多机器人任务分配方法，用于应对不确定性和通信约束，并在无人机配送领域进行了测试。
summary_zh: 我们研究在任务完成状态不确定、存在时间窗约束且信息不完整条件下的动态多机器人任务分配问题。任务在有限时间范围内在线到达且必须在规定截止期限前完成，而智能体在分布式枢纽中运行，感知与通信能力有限。我们通过基于枢纽的感知区域（决定任务可见性）和通信网络（控制枢纽间信息交换）对信息不完整进行建模。在此框架下，我们提出迭代最优响应策略——一种去中心化策略，每个智能体选择能够最大化其对局部观测效能边际贡献的任务。我们在城市级包裹配送场景中，比较了该策略与最早截止期限优先、匈牙利算法以及随机冲突分配算法三种基准方法的表现，实验规模涉及100架无人机及多种任务到达情境。实验表明，在完整通信和稀疏通信条件下，迭代最优响应策略均能以更短的计算时间实现具有竞争力的任务完成性能。

title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents
summary: Language Model (LM) agents are increasingly used in complex open-ended decision-making tasks, from AI coding to physical AI. A core requirement in these settings is the ability to both explore the problem space and exploit acquired knowledge effectively. However, systematically distinguishing and quantifying exploration and exploitation from observed actions without access to the agent's internal policy remains challenging. To address this, we design controllable environments inspired by practical embodied AI scenarios. Each environment consists of a partially observable 2D grid map and an unknown task Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). The map generation can be programmatically adjusted to emphasize exploration or exploitation difficulty. To enable policy-agnostic evaluation, we design a metric to quantify exploration and exploitation errors from agent's actions. We evaluate a variety of frontier LM agents and find that even state-of-the-art models struggle on our task, with different models exhibiting distinct failure modes. We further observe that reasoning models solve the task more effectively and show both exploration and exploitation can be significantly improved through minimal harness engineering. We release our code \href{https://github.com/jjj-madison/measurable-explore-exploit}{here}.
tldr: This paper introduces a method to measure exploration and exploitation errors for Language Model agents in programmatically generated, partially observable 2D grid environments inspired by embodied AI scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于在受具身AI场景启发的、程序化生成的部分可观察2D网格环境中，测量语言模型智能体的探索和利用错误。
summary_zh: 语言模型（LM）智能体正日益广泛地应用于复杂的开放式决策任务中，从AI编码到实体AI领域皆是如此。在这些场景中，一个核心需求是智能体既能够有效探索问题空间，又能够充分利用已获取的知识。然而，如何在不获取智能体内部策略的情况下，仅凭观察到的行为来系统性地区分并量化探索与利用过程，仍然存在挑战。为此，我们基于实际实体AI场景设计了可控的实验环境。每个环境包含一个部分可观测的二维网格地图和一个未知任务的**有向无环图（DAG）**。地图的生成可通过程序化调整来强化探索或利用的难度。为了实现与策略无关的评估，我们设计了一种度量指标，用于根据智能体的行为量化探索与利用误差。我们对多种前沿语言模型智能体进行了评估，发现即使是最先进的模型在此任务中仍表现困难，且不同模型呈现出明显的失败模式差异。进一步观察发现，具备推理能力的模型能更有效地解决任务，并且通过简单的约束工程即可显著提升探索与利用的能力。我们的代码已发布于\href{https://github.com/jjj-madison/measurable-explore-exploit}{此处}。

title: A hierarchical spatial-aware algorithm with efficient reinforcement learning for human-robot task planning and allocation in production
summary: In advanced manufacturing systems, humans and robots collaborate to conduct the production process. Effective task planning and allocation (TPA) is crucial for achieving high production efficiency, yet it remains challenging in complex and dynamic manufacturing environments. The dynamic nature of humans and robots, particularly the need to consider spatial information (e.g., humans' real-time position and the distance they need to move to complete a task), substantially complicates TPA. To address the above challenges, we decompose production tasks into manageable subtasks. We then implement a real-time hierarchical human-robot TPA algorithm, including a high-level agent for task planning and a low-level agent for task allocation. For the high-level agent, we propose an efficient buffer-based deep Q-learning method (EBQ), which reduces training time and enhances performance in production problems with long-term and sparse reward challenges. For the low-level agent, a path planning-based spatially aware method (SAP) is designed to allocate tasks to the appropriate human-robot resources, thereby achieving the corresponding sequential subtasks. We conducted experiments on a complex real-time production process in a 3D simulator. The results demonstrate that our proposed EBQ&SAP method effectively addresses human-robot TPA problems in complex and dynamic production processes.
tldr: A hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm for human-robot task planning and allocation in production, featuring a high-level buffer-based DQN for task planning and a low-level spatial-aware path planner for task allocation, validated in a 3D simulator.
tldr_zh: 一种用于生产中人机任务规划与分配的分层强化学习算法，包含用于任务规划的高层缓冲型DQN和用于任务分配的低层空间感知路径规划器，并在3D模拟器中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 在先进制造系统中，人与机器人协作完成生产过程。有效的任务规划与分配对于实现高效生产至关重要，但在复杂动态的制造环境中仍面临挑战。人与机器人的动态特性，尤其是需考虑空间信息（如人员的实时位置及其完成任务需移动的距离），显著增加了任务规划与分配的复杂性。为应对上述挑战，我们将生产任务分解为可管理的子任务，并实现了一种实时分层人机任务规划与分配算法，包含用于任务规划的高层智能体和用于任务分配的低层智能体。针对高层智能体，我们提出一种高效的基于缓冲区的深度Q学习方法，该方法减少了训练时间，并在具有长期稀疏奖励挑战的生产问题中提升了性能。对于低层智能体，设计了一种基于路径规划的空间感知方法，用于将任务分配给合适的人机资源，从而完成相应的顺序子任务。我们在三维仿真环境中对复杂实时生产过程进行了实验，结果表明，所提出的EBQ&SAP方法能有效解决复杂动态生产过程中的人机任务规划与分配问题。

title: DINO-Explorer: Active Underwater Discovery via Ego-Motion Compensated Semantic Predictive Coding
summary: Marine ecosystem degradation necessitates continuous, scientifically selective underwater monitoring. However, most autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operate as passive data loggers, capturing exhaustive video for offline review and frequently missing transient events of high scientific value. Transitioning to active perception requires a causal, online signal that highlights significant phenomena while suppressing maneuver-induced visual changes. We propose DINO-Explorer, a novelty-aware perception framework driven by a continuous semantic surprise signal. Operating within the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 foundation model, it leverages a lightweight, action-conditioned recurrent predictor to anticipate short-horizon semantic evolution. An efference-copy-inspired module utilizes globally pooled optical flow to discount self-induced visual changes without suppressing genuine environmental novelty. We evaluate this signal on the downstream task of asynchronous event triage under variant telemetry constraints. Results demonstrate that DINO-Explorer provides a robust, bandwidth-efficient attention mechanism. At a fixed operating point, the system retains 78.8% of post-discovery human-reviewer consensus events with a 56.8% trigger confirmation rate, effectively surfacing mission-relevant phenomena. Crucially, ego-motion conditioning suppresses 45.5% of false positives relative to an uncompensated surprise signal baseline. In a replay-side Pareto ablation study, DINO-Explorer robustly dominates the validated peak F1 versus telemetry bandwidth frontier, reducing telemetry bandwidth by 48.2% at the selected operating point while maintaining a 62.2% peak F1 score, successfully concentrating data transmission around human-verified novelty events.
tldr: This paper introduces DINO-Explorer, a novelty-aware perception framework for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs). It uses an ego-motion compensated semantic surprise signal from a frozen DINOv3 foundation model to actively identify and triage scientifically significant underwater events, improving telemetry bandwidth efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出DINO-Explorer，这是一种用于自主水下航行器（AUV）的新颖感知框架。它利用冻结的DINOv3基础模型和自运动补偿的语义“惊奇”信号，主动识别和筛选具有科学意义的海洋事件，从而提高了遥测带宽效率。
summary_zh: 海洋生态系统退化要求进行持续且具有科学选择性的水下监测。然而，大多数自主水下航行器（AUV）仅作为被动数据记录器运行，需要捕获大量视频供离线审查，常常错过具有高科学价值的瞬态事件。要实现主动感知，需要一种因果性的在线信号，既能凸显重要现象，又能抑制航行器机动引起的视觉变化。我们提出了DINO-Explorer，一种由连续语义新奇信号驱动的新颖感知框架。该框架在冻结的DINOv3基础模型的潜在空间内运行，通过轻量化的动作条件循环预测器来预测短期语义演化。受传出信号副本启发的模块利用全局汇集的光流来抵消自致视觉变化，同时不压制真实的环境新奇性。我们在不同遥测约束下的异步事件分诊下游任务中评估了这一信号。结果表明，DINO-Explorer提供了一种鲁棒且带宽高效的注意力机制。在固定工作点下，该系统保留了78.8%经人工复核确认的事件，触发确认率达56.8%，能有效呈现与任务相关的现象。关键的是，相对于未经补偿的新奇信号基线，自我运动补偿将误报率降低了45.5%。在回放侧帕累托消融研究中，DINO-Explorer在验证的峰值F1分数与遥测带宽边界上持续保持优势，在选定工作点将遥测带宽降低48.2%的同时，仍维持62.2%的峰值F1分数，成功将数据传输集中于人工验证的新奇事件周围。

title: Actuation space reduction to facilitate insightful shape matching in a novel reconfigurable tendon driven continuum manipulator
summary: In tendon driven continuum manipulators (TDCMs), reconfiguring the tendon routing enables tailored spatial deformation of the backbone. This work presents a design in which tendons can be rerouted either prior to or after actuation by actively rotating the individual spacer disks. Each disk rotation thus adds a degree of freedom to the actuation space, complicating the mapping from a desired backbone curve to the corresponding actuator inputs. However, when the backbone shape is projected into an intermediate space defined by curvature and torsion (C-T), patterns emerge that highlight which disks are most influential in achieving a global shape. This insight enables a simplified, sequential shape-matching strategy: first, the proximal and intermediate disks are rotated to approximate the global shape; then, the distal disks are adjusted to fine-tune the end-effector position with minimal impact on the overall shape. The proposed actuation framework offers a model-free alternative to conventional control approaches, bypassing the complexities of modeling reconfigurable TDCMs.
tldr: This paper presents a model-free control framework for a novel reconfigurable tendon-driven continuum manipulator, using curvature-torsion projection to enable a simplified sequential shape-matching strategy.
tldr_zh: 本研究针对一种新型可重构肌腱驱动连续体机械臂，提出了一种基于曲率-扭转投影的无模型控制框架，通过简化的顺序形状匹配策略实现形状控制。
summary_zh: 在肌腱驱动连续体操纵器（TDCM）中，通过重新配置肌腱布线能够实现脊柱结构的定制化空间变形。本研究提出一种设计方案，即通过主动旋转各独立间隔盘，可在驱动前或驱动后对肌腱路径进行重定向。每个间隔盘的旋转由此为驱动空间增加了一个自由度，使得从期望的脊柱曲线到相应驱动器输入的映射关系变得复杂。然而，当脊柱形状投影到由曲率和挠率（C-T）定义的中间空间时，会呈现出特定模式，揭示哪些间隔盘对实现整体形状最具影响力。这一洞见促成了一种简化的顺序形状匹配策略：首先旋转近端和中间间隔盘以逼近整体形状；随后调整远端间隔盘，在最小化对整体形状影响的同时微调末端执行器位置。所提出的驱动框架为传统控制方法提供了一种无模型替代方案，规避了可重构TDCM建模的复杂性。

title: Learning step-level dynamic soaring in shear flow
summary: Dynamic soaring enables sustained flight by extracting energy from wind shear, yet it is commonly understood as a cycle-level maneuver that assumes stable flow conditions. In realistic unsteady environments, however, such assumptions are often violated, raising the question of whether explicit cycle-level planning is necessary. Here, we show that dynamic soaring can emerge from step-level, state-feedback control using only local sensing, without explicit trajectory planning. Using deep reinforcement learning as a tool, we obtain policies that achieve robust omnidirectional navigation across diverse shear-flow conditions. The learned behavior organizes into a structured control law that coordinates turning and vertical motion, giving rise to a two-phase strategy governed by a trade-off between energy extraction and directional progress. The resulting policy generalizes across varying conditions and reproduces key features observed in biological flight and optimal-control solutions. These findings identify a feedback-based control structure underlying dynamic soaring, demonstrating that efficient energy-harvesting flight can emerge from local interactions with the flow without explicit planning, and providing insights for biological flight and autonomous systems in complex, flow-coupled environments.
tldr: This paper uses deep reinforcement learning to learn step-level, state-feedback control policies for dynamic soaring in shear flows, showing that efficient energy-harvesting flight can emerge from local interactions without explicit planning.
tldr_zh: 本研究利用深度强化学习，学习在剪切流中实现动态翱翔的步级状态反馈控制策略，表明无需显式规划，高效的能量收集飞行可以通过与流动的局部交互自然涌现。
summary_zh: 动态翱翔通过从风切变中提取能量实现持续飞行，但通常被理解为一种基于循环层面的机动策略，其前提是假设稳定的流动条件。然而，在实际的非稳态环境中，这种假设往往难以成立，这引发了一个问题：是否必须进行显式的循环级轨迹规划？本文研究表明，动态翱翔可以通过仅依赖局部感知的步进级状态反馈控制实现，无需显式轨迹规划。利用深度强化学习作为工具，我们获得了能够在不同风切变条件下实现鲁棒全向导航的控制策略。学习到的行为组织成一种结构化控制律，协调转向与垂直运动，形成了一种由能量提取与方向推进之间的权衡所主导的两阶段策略。所得策略能够泛化至多种流动条件，并重现了生物飞行和最优控制解中观察到的关键特征。这些发现揭示了动态翱翔背后基于反馈的控制结构，证明了高效的能量获取飞行可以通过与流动的局部交互自然涌现而无须显式规划，为复杂流动耦合环境中的生物飞行与自主系统提供了新的见解。
